title: The Ice Drum and the Spiral Signs
moral: Exploration should respect history and nature.

scenes.text: Elias and Mina follow an old explorer’s journal to confirm a mysterious route across icy land.
scenes.image_prompt: two explorers in snowy tundra with sled and map under cloudy sky

scenes.text: They discover carved stones and spiral symbols marking an ancient path.
scenes.image_prompt: snowy landscape with stone cairn and carved spiral symbols

scenes.text: They explore a large ice hill that produces booming sounds and hides secrets beneath.
scenes.image_prompt: large icy hill with cracks and explorers observing cautiously

scenes.text: A crack reveals a hidden structure, but they choose not to enter to protect it.
scenes.image_prompt: icy cave opening glowing faintly with explorers observing from distance

scenes.text: They document everything carefully and leave the site untouched, respecting history.
scenes.image_prompt: explorers writing notes near snowy camp with sunset in background

story: Elias and Mina explore the Arctic following an old journal. They discover ancient markers and a mysterious ice hill but choose not to disturb hidden structures. Their journey highlights the importance of respecting history and nature while exploring.
